propositions: rebar must support an encrypted S3 bucket as the ticket-store remote by routing sync.remote s3:// URLs through the git-remote-s3 helper, preserving init/create/claim/push/fetch workflows with ticket data residing only in the encrypted bucket

concurrent or legacy pushes to S3 can leave multiple <sha>.bundle files for one ref, causing git ls-remote to return the ref at two SHAs and breaking fresh clones with 'multiple updates for ref not allowed'

when sync.remote is an s3:// URL and the git-remote-s3 helper is absent or below the minimum version, store init and push must fail immediately with an actionable error message naming the required pip install

the multi-bundle corruption state must self-heal non-interactively by merging all divergent heads under a repair lock, collapsing them to a single bundle while preserving all commits and events from every head
S3 backend configuration including optional [s3] dependency declaration, helper version pinning, SSE-KMS bucket setup, and sync.remote=s3://… usage must be documented for operator enablement
